## 4614f605ddab

**Reproduced lesson ambiguity.** The plausible rival “recolor every green
component cyan” fits all three demonstrations but changes the query for seed
830000, easy indices 61–64. The demonstrations' component edge-touch counts are
`[1,1]`, `[1,1,1]`, and `[1,1]`; the query counts are `[1,0,0]`. Canonical Racket
execution agrees with the rival on the first three and disagrees on the fourth.
The search found 12 such ambiguous three-demo windows among 2,988 consecutive
windows over 3,000 generated grids (1,000 indices per band).

Evidence: `checks/audit/4614f605ddab/all-green-shortcut.json`, exact inputs in
`checks/audit/4614f605ddab/ambiguous-window-inputs.json`, and canonical outputs
in `checks/audit/4614f605ddab/ambiguous-window-racket.json`. The apply record
binds generator SHA-256
`ef9a4fbd8c8bab22e65cb0b5b6a712fb172747b887e12031e3db582586864770`
and executed rule hash `c89487140e4b`. The target source was left unchanged.
A minimal repair is to guarantee at least one non-recolored interior or
multi-edge component in every three-demo lesson, then declare and test this rival.

## 4614f605ddab

**Reproduced semantic coverage defect.** Generator SHA-256
`ef9a4fbd8c8bab22e65cb0b5b6a712fb172747b887e12031e3db582586864770` emits only
colors 0 and 3. A 900-input source-bound scan (300 per band) found no other color
in any accepted grid: `checks/audit/4614f605ddab/scan.json`. Canonical examples,
by contrast, contain color-6 distractors that must remain unchanged even when
they touch exactly one border.

The retained 7x7 witness contains a top-edge green pair and a left-edge color-6
singleton: `checks/audit/4614f605ddab/input.json`. The target's `self_check`
returns `[]`, so it belongs to the accepted canonical-style domain. The canonical
Racket authority (rule hash `c89487140e4b`) recolors only the green pair and
preserves the 6. The rival “recolor every nonzero component touching exactly one
edge” also recolors the 6 to 8. Exact outputs and hashes are in
`checks/audit/4614f605ddab/counterexample.json`; supported apply evidence is in
`checks/audit/4614f605ddab/racket.json`.

Because every generated foreground component is green, the rival is
observationally identical on all 900 scanned samples. Add non-green edge and
interior distractors to teach the color predicate. No source was changed for this
audit target.
